name: Fieldnotes
author: Masthead
description: An editorial journal for indie blogs: a photo-led grid of stories, tall condensed headlines and an unhurried reading page.

tokens.label: Accent
tokens.description: Links and the active nav underline.

tokens.label: Headline font
tokens.description: Titles are set in capitals; a condensed face (Oranienbaum) gives the tall magazine look.

tokens.label: Reading font
tokens.description: The face for post and page text.

tokens.label: Grid columns
tokens.description: Columns on desktop. Drops to 2 on tablet and 1 on phone.

tokens.label: Card image shape
tokens.description: 'natural' keeps each photo's own proportions for a staggered grid.

tokens.label: Show tag filter on the homepage

page_options.label: Page layout
page_options.description: 'wide' lets the page body use the full grid width.

page_options.label: Show site navigation
page_options.description: Untick to hide the top nav bar on this page only.

post_options.label: Featured image
post_options.description: The photo on the post's card in the journal grid and at the top of the post.

post_options.label: Featured image alt text
post_options.description: Describes the photo for screen readers.

post_options.label: Caption
post_options.description: Shown under the photo on the post — a credit, or 'Shot on 35mm, Portra 400'.

post_options.label: Featured image on the post
post_options.description: wide: wider than the text. full: edge to edge. column: text width. hidden: only on the card.

post_options.label: Search description
post_options.description: Overrides the excerpt in the page's meta description and social previews.
